name: Leg Raise (Captain's Chair)
instructions: Support yourself on the arm rests with your back against the pad.
Raise your legs, keeping them straight, until they are parallel to the floor or higher.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A straight-leg raise in a captain's chair that trains the lower abs and hip flexors.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

attribution: Original prose written for the LIFT knowledge base (CC BY 4.0).
safetyNotes: Bend your knees to make it easier; avoid if you have lower-back pain.
